name: 7 Days to Die
hint: Zombie survival server, joined from the in-game browser through Steam networking

SERVER_NAME.title: Server name
SERVER_NAME.default: A Cloady 7 Days to Die server
SERVER_NAME.description: Steam players find the server by this name in the in-game server browser and join from there; with no public IPv4 the game falls back to Steam networking, which relays the connection. The first start downloads about 18 GB. Other settings live in serverfiles/sdtdserver.xml on the volume.

SERVER_PASSWORD.title: Server password
SERVER_PASSWORD.description: The server is listed publicly so players can find it; clear this for an open server.
